summary.zh: 假设计划一年后失败，倒推风险
summary.en: Assume the plan failed in 12 months, then work backward

description.zh: 先假设计划在十二个月后已经失败，再倒推哪些假设、外部依赖和执行环节出了问题。产出一份需要提前设防的风险清单。适合即将投入大量资源，或周围反馈过于乐观的时候。
description.en: Assumes the plan already failed twelve months out, then works backward to the assumptions, dependencies and execution gaps behind it. Produces a list of risks to guard against. Good before a big commitment.
